page.content:
Market town where Twilight Sparkle learns friendship with the Mane Six.

How Ponyville connects

  • Location: Equestria — Ponyville is a market town in Equestria.
  • Character: Twilight Sparkle — Twilight Sparkle moves to Ponyville to study friendship.
  • Faction: Mane Six — The Mane Six live and work in Ponyville.

What is Ponyville?

Ponyville is the earth-pony town of Sugarcube Corner, Sweet Apple Acres, and Carousel Boutique, the place Celestia sends Twilight Sparkle so the Mane Six can form.

Key threads lead to Equestria, Twilight Sparkle and Mane Six.
